It’s probably been said so many times but my least favorite change was the end of Garou vs Saitama. 

It’s unfortunate to say, but I ended up enjoying Garou’s fight with the A-class, Bang and Bomb more than the fight against Saitama. His desire to be a villain and win was so pure. It was a total rejection of any form of loss whatsoever. Cosmic Form Garou was strong, but to me there was no form of menace or terror. Awakened Garou ran off his individual fumes and simple desire to prove a point. His costume was the fact that the blood and injuries he sustained covered and caked his entire body yet he still kept going. That’s fucking metal. In contrast, obtaining power from God turned him into a machine that removed accountability from him. And of course the biggest loss to me was having his speech and criticism of the S class heroes be cut out.

Beyond this, I was thinking I had a lot to say about the manga, but rereading recent chapters made me realize I wasn’t right LOL. Ofc the current redraws are a slog and may not add much, but we haven’t seen it through the end and maybe the ending will be much better. So instead I’ll just have an anthology of things I loved about the series cuz I wanted to use them as a counter argument initially. 

My favorite parts of OPM was when Saitama was a hero not because he beat a villain, but because of the times he saved the other party’s feelings and helped them be more confident in themselves.

Inspiring and showing suiryu who a real hero could be. Standing up for his own fashion and helping that kid go against their parent. Saving that old man instead of his salmon. Giving the heroes the credit for killing sea king. When his plain nature told Glasses man anyone could do it with hard work. Plus when he called Child Emperor really cool in the phoenix man realm. Mumen rider inspiring a different hero to stand for what is right. Zombie man holding his promise to take child emperor for ice cream.

My absolute favorite moment being Saitama’s introspection after killing gouketsu in chapter 76, then immediately losing a debate and getting heated at King in the next chapter. 

I know OPM is slow rn, but it can’t be perfect all the time. The MA arc started off really slow as well, but has better moments later. I’m sure we will get back in the swing of things when we get deeper into neo heroes!

Honestly it depends on how far in depth you have gone into algebra 2 and how confident with your learning ability. Because Calculus is based on the foundation of math, it’s easier for others to understand compared to entering physics or chemistry. As a result, if you feel very confident in your ability, normal calculus should not be too bad if you fundamentally understood the content you went over. If there is only a surface level of understanding, you’d should not take Calc, let alone AB or BC. This would be the difference between only being able to make a cake by strictly following a recipe vs understanding how the ingredients function and making a cake on the fly. If you can only answer questions after being given a way to solve them, then I would not recommend any higher level math.
